fonti.titolo: Independent Authority for Public Revenue (AADE) - climate resilience fee page
fonti.nota: Blocks automated reading (403): checked by hand each quarter.

note: The fee is charged per room or apartment per night, not per person: two people sharing a room pay one fee.

esenzioni: Accommodation provided free of charge (the fee is not imposed)

destinazioni.etichetta_prezzo: Accommodation price per night, excluding VAT (all rooms booked)

categorie.label: Hotels, holiday villages, guesthouses and other paid accommodation

tariffe.nota: Rate in Law 6802 art. 34 once Decision 11263 expires on 31/12/2026, unless a new decision changes it.

destinazioni.chi_riscuote: The accommodation provider, on the invoice.

fonti.titolo: Presidential Decision No. 11263, Official Gazette (Resmî Gazete) No. 33240, 1 May 2026: accommodation tax rate set at 1% until 31/12/2026
Revenue Administration (GİB) - accommodation tax return guide: rate 2%, base = invoice amount excluding VAT

note: The accommodation tax (konaklama vergisi) is a percentage of the price excluding VAT of the overnight stay and of the other services sold together with it at the property (food, drinks, activities, entertainment, pool, spa and similar), so with board or all-inclusive the base is wider than the room alone.
From 1 May 2026 to 31 December 2026 the rate is 1% (Presidential Decision 11263). Before that it was 2%, the rate in the law.
If you booked a package, check with your tour operator or hotel whether the tax is already included.
The tax is national: the same rate applies in Istanbul, Antalya, Bodrum, Dalaman, Fethiye, Marmaris and Cappadocia.

note: The accommodation tax (konaklama vergisi) is a percentage of the price excluding VAT of the overnight stay and of the other services sold together with it at the property (food, drinks, activities, entertainment, pool, spa and similar), so with board or all-inclusive the base is wider than the room alone.
From 1 May 2026 to 31 December 2026 the rate is 1% (Presidential Decision 11263). Before that it was 2%, the rate in the law.
If you booked a package, check with your tour operator or hotel whether the tax is already included.

note: 12.5% of the price of the overnight stay, excluding VAT and excluding the tourist tax itself. Charges closely linked to the stay (cleaning, bed linen, towels) count even if invoiced separately; breakfast, food and drinks do not.
There is no age exemption and no cap on the number of nights.
Amsterdam also has a separate day-tourist tax (dagtoeristenbelasting), not covered here.
esenzioni: People staying in recognised care institutions
Government-arranged shelter for refugees and homeless people

note: 7.5% of the price of the overnight stay, excluding VAT and excluding other services such as breakfast.
Business trips are taxed too. The old rule that ended the tax after 21 nights was abolished from 2025; stays offered for less than six months are covered.
There is no age exemption in the law.

fonti.titolo: City of Vienna - Ortstaxe (rates until 30 June 2026, from 1 July 2026 and from 1 July 2027; exemptions)

note: From 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027: 5% of the price of the stay, excluding VAT and breakfast.
Until 30 June 2026 it was 3.2% after a flat 11% deduction; from 1 July 2027 it will be 8%.
The City of Vienna also publishes an official online Ortstaxe calculator for hosts.
People who stay more than 3 months without interruption in the accommodation are exempt: the calculator shows no tax for such stays.
esenzioni: Minors staying for school or vocational training, or in youth hostels
Students at Vienna universities and colleges (Studierende an Wiener Hoch- oder Fachschulen)
People staying more than 3 months without interruption in the accommodation

Act No. 565/1990 on local fees, current version (§3b exemptions incl. persons under 18; §3c base = days of stay except arrival day), e-Sbírka

note: 50 CZK per person for each day of the stay except the day of arrival (so one fee per night).

Only paid stays lasting at most 60 consecutive calendar days with the same provider are covered. The arrival day counts as a day of the stay, so a stay of 60 nights or more (61+ calendar days) is outside the fee.
Under-18s are exempt by national law.
Other exemptions in national law include blind and severely disabled people (ZTP/P) with a companion, and people hospitalised in the city.
esenzioni: Persons under 18
Blind people, ZTP/P card holders and their companion
Hospitalised patients (except spa care)
Seasonal workers
Some social and emergency stays

fonti.titolo: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Bureau of Taxation - accommodation tax FAQ (current rates, April 2027 change, children)

fonti.titolo: Welsh Government (gov.wales) - Visitor Levy in Wales / Visitor Levy in Cardiff: stays from 1 April 2027, £1.30 and 75p per person per night, refunds
fonti.nota: Open Government Licence: contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

fonti.titolo: Welsh Revenue Authority guide, step 2 - Check if your council charges the levy: Cardiff Council starts the levy on 1 April 2027
Welsh Revenue Authority guide, step 4 - How much you must pay: rates, under-18s at the lower rate, bookings of 32 nights or more
Welsh Revenue Authority guide, step 5 - Record new bookings in advance: Cardiff bookings made from 28 September 2026

note: The Visitor Levy starts in Cardiff on 1 April 2027. No other Welsh council charges it or is consulting on it on the date we checked.

£1.30 per person per night (guests of all ages, babies included) in hotels, B&Bs, self-catering, holiday lets, caravans, glamping and homestays; 75p per adult per night in shared hostel rooms, bunkhouses, bothies, dormitories and tent pitches, where under-18s do not pay.
It applies to bookings made from 28 September 2026 (and to nights or guests added to an earlier booking from that date) for stays from 1 April 2027.
One booking of 32 nights or more is not charged (the nights do not have to be in a row).
After the stay, carers looking after a disabled person, people who were temporarily homeless and people fleeing harm or domestic violence can ask the Welsh Revenue Authority for a refund.

It applies to bookings made from 28 September 2026; one booking of 32 nights or more is not charged.

note: Foreign guests pay 12 dinars per night in 4- and 5-star hotels, 8 dinars in 3-star hotels and 4 dinars in 2-star hotels and the other types of accommodation listed; Tunisian and Maghreb nationals pay 3, 2 and 1 dinars.
The amount paid by each guest cannot exceed 10 nights spent in a row.

Article 46 does not mention children. The 2018 law it amends charges guests over 12, according to the Ministry of Finance in Parliament (November 2023): ask your hotel whether children pay, as the calculator counts every guest. If you booked a package, check with your tour operator whether the tax is included.
The tax is national: the same rates apply in Djerba, Hammamet, Sousse, Monastir, Tunis and Tozeur.
destinazioni.breve_seo: TND 4–12 per night for foreign guests
destinazioni.risposta: In Tunisia foreign guests pay 4 to 12 dinars per person per night: TND 12 in 4- and 5-star hotels, TND 8 in 3-star hotels and TND 4 in 2-star hotels and other accommodation; Tunisian and Maghreb nationals pay TND 3, 2 and 1. Each guest pays for at most 10 nights in a row.

categorie.label: Foreign visitor entering Quintana Roo (any age)

destinazioni.chi_riscuote: Paid online on the official Visitax portal of the Quintana Roo Tax Administration Service (SATQ), or through companies authorised by the SATQ; not at the hotel.

fonti.titolo: Ley de Derechos del Estado de Quintana Roo, article 51-Octies: 2.50 UMA per foreign visitor (last reform published 18 December 2025)
INEGI - UMA 2026: MXN 117.31 per day from 1 February 2026 (press release 1/26, 8 January 2026)
Visitax - official payment portal of the Quintana Roo Tax Administration Service (SATQ), FAQ: mandatory for all foreign tourists, no adult or child rate, applies to Cozumel

note: The amount is set by law as 2.50 UMA (Unidad de Medida y Actualización), the official reference value in pesos that INEGI updates every January, valid from 1 February. So the Visitax changes every 1 February.
The official portal says there is no adult or child rate: all foreign tourists pay, whatever their age.
